The Asset Sale, which has been unanimously approved by the board of directors of the Company (the "Board"), is currently expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to approval by the Company's stockholders and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions.

If the Asset Sale closes, the Company will exit the operation of its current biotechnology business and other historical operations, but it does not intend to liquidate and will remain a publicly traded company.

It is currently uncertain what businesses or assets the Company may acquire or invest in following the closing of the Asset Sale, and the Board intends to evaluate opportunities to create value for the benefit of stockholders.
If the payment of the debt is accelerated, absent any additional funding, cash flows from our operations will be insufficient to repay such debt in full.

Therefore, if all outstanding amounts under the Working Capital Facility Agreement are accelerated, management expects there will be substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern for a period of at least one year from the date of issuance of the condensed consolidated financial statements included in this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.

The completion of the Asset Sale is subject to approval by the Company’s stockholders and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions, and there can be no assurance that the Company will be successful in obtaining stockholder approval or closing the Asset Sale on the anticipated timeline, on the terms currently contemplated, or at all.
